subjects.description: A large, dry, spherical tumbleweed composed of tangled brittle branches, pale tan to golden-brown in color, loosely woven and airy in structure
subjects.appearance_details: Wispy protruding twigs, semi-transparent gaps between branches, small bits of dust and debris shaking loose as it rolls, casting a fragmented shadow on the asphalt
subjects.relationship: The primary moving obstacle crossing the ego vehicle's path on an otherwise empty highway
subjects.location: Enters from right midground, crosses toward center then exits toward left verge
subjects.orientation: Rolling and tumbling, no fixed facing direction
subjects.pose: Rounded, chaotic tangled mass in continuous rotation
subjects.action: Rolling and bouncing across the highway from right to left ahead of the vehicle
subjects.state_changes: Bounces lightly as it crosses the ego lane, momentarily lifting off the road surface before continuing toward the left verge

background_setting: A straight two-lane desert highway stretching toward a distant flat horizon under a clear blue daytime sky. The asphalt is faded gray with a worn yellow center dividing line and dust accumulated along both shoulders. Flanking the road are arid sandy verges dotted with sparse scrub brush, dry grasses, low desert vegetation, and scattered rocks. Distant low hills and mesas shimmer faintly in the heat haze along the horizon. No other vehicles, structures, or people are present.

lighting.direction: High sun, slightly front-and-side lighting the scene
lighting.shadows: Short, sharp, consistent shadows cast directly beneath the tumbleweed and roadside brush on the sunlit asphalt
lighting.illumination_effect: Crisp, high-contrast desert illumination with strong glare off the road surface and vivid sky saturation

aesthetics.composition: Symmetrical first-person driving composition with the highway receding to a central vanishing point; horizon placed on upper third; tumbleweed animates across the lower-middle frame
aesthetics.color_scheme: Warm sandy tans and beiges of the desert against the cool blue of the clear sky and neutral gray asphalt
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Quiet, isolated, sun-baked, expansive open-road calm
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating dashed center line and rhythmic roadside scrub receding into distance

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking shot from the ego vehicle moving at steady cruising speed; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.focus: Sharp across the road ahead, the tumbleweed, and distant horizon

context: Autonomous driving / dashcam perspective demonstrating a vehicle maintaining course through a harmless roadside obstacle

actions.description: Ego vehicle cruises forward on the empty straight desert highway; road clear ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

A large dry tumbleweed enters from the right verge and begins rolling onto the highway. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The tumbleweed bounces lightly across the ego lane ahead of the vehicle, tumbling toward the center. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle continues at cruising speed through the tumbleweed's path without slowing; the tumbleweed rolls off toward the left verge. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the camera shows a first-person view driving forward on a straight, empty two-lane desert highway under a clear blue sky with sharp midday shadows. By 0:01 a large dry tumbleweed appears at the right edge of the road and begins rolling onto the asphalt. Between 0:02 and 0:03 the tumbleweed tumbles across the ego lane directly ahead of the vehicle, bouncing lightly off the road surface as it moves toward the center. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle continues at its steady cruising speed straight through the tumbleweed's path without slowing or stopping, while the tumbleweed rolls onward and off toward the left verge, leaving the open desert road clear ahead once more. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Steady low hum of the vehicle's engine and continuous tire-on-asphalt road noise, with a faint whoosh of wind. A brief soft rustling and scraping sound as the dry tumbleweed bounces across the road. No music, speech, or other traffic.
